sideBySideRule: Experimental scoring only; live DEFAULT_SCANNER_CONFIG, TOP_15_OVERALL, and config/paper-rules-v5.json remain fixed.
contaminationDisclosure: 2026-08-27..2026-11-20 was previously evaluated in #124 and 2026-08-27..2026-11-19 was peeked in the #127 paper-trading replay (-0.558%/day gross on TOP_15_OVERALL, -13.7% universe). No candidate below was designed or tuned around that peek; no data >= 2026-08-27 may be read during development; Auditor will verify anti-peek compliance before any single HeldOutSeal look.

candidates.description: Winsorized cross-sectional z-score blend using existing 5-factor weights (0.25/0.20/0.20/0.20/0.15), top 15.
candidates.rationale: Production min-max normalization is distorted by single-stock extreme outliers; winsorized z-scores stabilize cross-sectional rankings without changing factor economics.

candidates.description: Winsorized cross-sectional z-score blend using existing 5-factor weights, top 30.
candidates.rationale: Doubling breadth from 15 to 30 reduces idiosyncratic variance and drawdown while diluting daily rank-boundary turnover.

candidates.description: Winsorized z-score 5-factor composite with rank-retention hysteresis (enter <= 15, hold until rank > 45).
candidates.rationale: Pre-#136 v2 baseline TOP_15_OVERALL incurred 0.49 daily turnover (~12%/yr cost drag); a hold buffer targets similar gross exposure with much lower slippage (compared against the post-#136 baseline).

candidates.description: Winsorized z-score 5-factor composite with rank-retention hysteresis (enter <= 25, hold until rank > 60).
candidates.rationale: Combines broader 25-name diversification with turnover damping to lower both slippage and drawdown.

candidates.description: 1-day close-to-close mean reversion (-return1d) restricted to top-half dollar-volume eligible stocks, top 20.
candidates.rationale: Liquid US equities often mean-revert over 1-day horizons due to temporary order-flow imbalances; restricting to upper-half liquidity avoids micro-cap bid-ask bounce.

candidates.description: Volatility-scaled 5-day reversal (-RETURN_5D / VOLATILITY_20D) on eligible stocks, top 20.
candidates.rationale: Standardizes short-term 5-day oversold moves by each stock's realized volatility so high-beta noise does not dominate the list.

candidates.description: Fade sharp single-day intraday moves (-intradayReturn1d) weighted by normalized volumeRatio5v20, top 20.
candidates.rationale: High-volume intraday dislocations often partially revert at subsequent opens once liquidity replenishes.

candidates.description: Intermediate 60-day momentum skipping the latest 5-day short-term reversal (z(MOMENTUM_60D) - z(RETURN_5D)), top 20.
candidates.rationale: Classic skip-week momentum separates intermediate trend persistence from 1-week short-term reversal noise.

candidates.description: Risk-adjusted 60-day momentum (MOMENTUM_60D / VOLATILITY_20D) blended equally with DRAWDOWN_60D proximity, top 20.
candidates.rationale: Raw momentum selects high-volatility lottery winners; scaling by volatility and shallow drawdown targets steadier trend leaders.

candidates.description: Risk-adjusted 60-day momentum + DRAWDOWN_60D with rank hysteresis (enter <= 20, hold until rank > 50).
candidates.rationale: Retains smooth risk-adjusted trend exposure while suppressing daily churn around the top-20 boundary.

candidates.description: Equal z-score blend of upDays20d consistency, RETURN_20D, and low VOLATILITY_20D, top 20.
candidates.rationale: Frog-in-the-pan trend consistency (many small positive days) has historically shown stronger continuation than single-spike returns.

candidates.description: Filter MOMENTUM_60D > 0, then rank by volatility-scaled 5-day pullback (-RETURN_5D / VOLATILITY_20D), top 20.
candidates.rationale: Buys temporary 5-day pullbacks inside stocks with established 60-day uptrends rather than chasing overextended highs.

candidates.description: Vol-scaled improvement (improvement / VOLATILITY_20D) with rank hysteresis (enter <= 20, hold until rank > 50).
candidates.rationale: FASTEST_IMPROVING had the highest pre-#136 dev gross return (+0.214%/day) and highest turnover (0.59); vol-scaling and hysteresis test whether cutting churn preserves net edge (to be compared against the post-#136 baseline).

backfillNote: Pre-#136 dev baseline numbers (variants.jsonl seq 5-9) were measured on ACTIVE-only local bars; after #136 delisted backfill lands, the dev baseline must be re-run under a new derived scanner label before scoring candidates so comparisons are survivorship-clean and apples-to-apples.
